svg.title: When the next refresh cycle starts
svg.desc: With targetCycleDurationMillis of 1000 ms, a cycle that takes 900 ms, and minimumInterCycleSleep of 200 ms, the next cycle starts at 1100 ms, the later of the two. If interCycleYield is true, the refresh thread calls Thread.yield as the cycle ends.
